info.title: ZIP Code Distance Match API Reference
info.description: Find all pairs of postal codes within a specified distance threshold from a list of up to 100 input codes. Specify a maximum distance and receive every pair of codes whose separation is at or below that value; if no pairs fall within the threshold, a 200 with an empty results array is returned rather than a 404. Supports six distance units: kilometers, miles, yards, meters, feet, and inches. A `country` code is always required. Results include each matched pair with its calculated distance.

servers.description: ZIP Code Distance Match API Server

post.summary: Get matching ZIP/postal code pairs within a distance
post.description: Returns every pair of the requested ZIP/postal codes whose distance from each other is at or below the given threshold.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

requestBody.description: The list of codes, their country, and an optional distance threshold and unit.

200.description: Successful response with matching ZIP code pairs. If none of the codes are within the distance threshold of each other, results is an empty array — this is not a 404.

400.description: Bad Request — Missing/invalid body, country, or unit, or over the 100-code limit

value.message: Request body is missing required fields or is not in the expected format. Please refer to the API documentation.
Provide a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

BadCountry.summary: country is not a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code

value.message: Only ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes country codes are supported.

InvalidUnit.summary: unit is not one of the supported symbols

value.message: The provided unit symbol is invalid. Please refer to the documentation for supported units.
A maximum of 100 postal/zip codes can be processed per request.

404.description: Not Found — None of the submitted codes matched anything

value.message: None of the provided postal/zip codes were found in our database.

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

ZipcodeDistanceMatchResponse.description: Matching ZIP/postal code pairs within the requested distance threshold.

result_count.description: Number of matching ZIP/postal code pairs returned. Zero when no pairs fall within the threshold.

results.description: Array of matching code pairs within the requested distance threshold.

ZipcodeDistanceMatchItem.description: A single matched pair of ZIP/postal codes with the distance between them.

code_1.description: First ZIP/postal code in the pair.

code_2.description: Second ZIP/postal code in the pair.

distance.description: Distance between the ZIP/postal code pair, in the unit specified by the unit field (default km).

DistanceMatchRequest.description: Request body specifying the codes, country, and distance threshold to match pairs within.

codes.description: List of ZIP or postal codes to find pairs within the specified distance. Maximum 100 codes.

country.description: Country of the codes in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format. Required.

distance.description: Maximum distance threshold. All pairs within this distance are returned. If omitted, the API applies a default threshold.

DistanceMatchInputCode.description: A ZIP or postal code to find distance matches for.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the API on failed requests.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.
